description: This file defines the EmployeeTrackerModel class within the OrangeHRM Performance API module. It models a performance tracker entity for employees, including serialization rules, property filters, and attribute mappings. The class uses traits and interacts with PerformanceTracker and employee entities to facilitate data normalization and API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerModel
classes.description: A model class representing an employee's performance tracker, including serialization configuration and entity mapping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PerformanceTracker entity and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization.
